newsitem.title: UK: Betterware says current trade on course.
newsitem.headline: Betterware says current trade on course.

text.p: British houseware retailer Betterware Plc said on Wednesday that its business in the first 12 weeks of the current year had progressed in line with expectations.
Addressing shareholders at the annual meeting, chairman Andrew Cohen said the group was now trading in 11 markets outside the UK.
"...And we are confident that out target to have 50 percent of sales from overseas markets within five years will be achieved," Cohen said.
Betterware had announced a special dividend of 9.31 pence/share and along with its final dividend of 2.52 pence for each share, will pay out 12.5 million stg to shareholders.
Cohen said that despite the pay-out the company would have ample resources to continue business development.
